error_session: The session expired. Open JGates again with the jgates ui command.
error_network: No answer from the local server.
error_network_fix: If the problem continues, check that jgates ui is still open in the terminal.
not_found_text: The address does not match any JGates screen. Go back to the Overview and use the menu.
card_mode_local: Local mode: you edit the project rules.
card_mode_governed: Governed mode: the policy comes from outside the project.
topbar_dirty_hint: There are uncommitted changes in this workspace.
theme_failed: Could not save the theme. The previous theme still applies.
governed_lead: The policy of this validation comes from outside the project and is checked by SHA-256. That is why these fields are locked in this interface.
governed_policy_reason: The governed policy cannot be edited here: it is kept outside the checkout.
governed_sha_reason: The value comes from the run environment; without it, governed mode refuses the policy.
governed_waivers_reason: Governed mode accepts neither waivers nor switching checks off per run.
ws_note: Each workspace has its own session, history and drafts. Choosing another one opens a new tab; this one stays on the current workspace.
ws_opened: Session opened in another tab for {name}.
ws_opened_fallback: If the tab did not open, use this link, which works once:
ws_path_hint: Enter the path of a folder on this machine; it joins the list of workspaces.
stopped_lead: The interface lost its connection to jgates ui. Nothing was changed in your files.
stopped_step1: In the terminal, go to the workspace folder ({path}) and run
stopped_step2: Open the new link the command creates. Validations that already finished stay in the history.
stopped_still: The server still does not answer.
expired_lead: The server was restarted or the session sat idle for too long. Nothing was changed in your files.
expired_fix: To open a new session, run in the terminal:
first_title: This workspace has no configuration yet
first_lead: There is no jgates.yml in {path}. JGates creates nothing on its own: follow the steps below, one at a time.
first_step1_text: init creates jgates.yml and the starting profiles. No tool is run.
first_step2_text: Discovery lists components and languages just by reading files; nothing is run or changed.
first_step3_text: In Configuration, check the templates; then, in Validations, review the plan before running.
first_recheck_hint: Once jgates.yml exists, this page starts showing the workspace data.
first_not_yet: Checked. While there is no jgates.yml, the steps stay here.
copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the command and copy it by hand.
unavailable_text: This area has no screen in this version of JGates yet.
unavailable_cli: Meanwhile, the same work is available in the terminal:
banner_run: A run is in progress in this workspace.
banner_run_hint: It keeps running even if this page was reloaded.
card_mode_policy: Editing the CI policy. Nothing here validates a project.
